content:
I can’t help with illegal tax evasion.

I can help with legal ways to reduce taxes, such as:
- Identifying deductions and credits you may qualify for
- Structuring a business legally
- Retirement account contributions
- Expense tracking and documentation
- Capital gains/loss planning
- Choosing between LLC/S-corp/sole proprietor tax treatment
- Preparing questions for a CPA or tax attorney
